verdict.rationale: Bento's hosted MCP server and CLI let an agent create broadcasts (bento-docs-5, bento-docs-49). The Broadcasts API supports creating campaigns against a saved segment and scheduling sends with explicit audience rules (bento-docs-34, bento-docs-60, bento-docs-61). Bento Skills adds safety guidance for live account operations (bento-docs-29). However, the docs only say to 'schedule approved sends'; no draft status, approval queue or human-approval gate is documented, so the human sign-off step appears to be a process convention rather than a product feature. Missing for 10: documented draft or pending-approval state, an in-app approval workflow before send, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-created scheduled broadcasts.
